description.value: River City Coffee Roasters, Bakery & Eatery is Powell River's first and longest-running coffee roaster, established in 1994. The cafe seats more than 80 people in a spacious room with high industrial ceilings, cozy nooks, and a sun-kissed patio — a welcoming stop after a ride. Food is made to order from scratch with full breakfast and lunch menus, daily specials, and a dedicated baking program.

address.value: #108 4871 Joyce Ave, Powell River, BC V8A 3B7

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is rich and confirms an active, open business at #108 4871 Joyce Ave, Powell River, BC with phone (604) 485-0011. Gluten-free and vegan options are explicitly confirmed ('Our entire menu can be made gluten-free, plus we have an extensive list of vegan options'). Online ordering and catering confirm takeout capability. No bike-specific amenities (rack, pump, Wi-Fi, charging, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM name is 'River City Coffee' but the business operates under the fuller name 'River City Coffee Roasters, Bakery & Eatery' per the website.
OSM record has no address or phone; both are taken from the website only, so contact_confirmed fields are null rather than true.

Community is tagged 'Unknown / Vancouver Island & Gulf Islands' but Powell River is on the BC Sunshine Coast (mainland), not Vancouver Island or the Gulf Islands — the website itself calls it 'the Sunshine Coast's first and longest-running coffee roaster.' The community tag appears to be a geographic miscategorization.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible cafe and coffee roaster in Powell River with confirmed food service, online ordering, and dietary accommodations relevant to touring cyclists.
